headline: Cabinet approves Secretariat relocation to Sher-e-Bangla Nagar by 2029
summary: The government has decided to move the Bangladesh Secretariat to the former trade fair grounds, with operations targeted to begin at the new site by 2029.
details: The government has decided to relocate the Bangladesh Secretariat to the former trade fair grounds in Sher-e-Bangla Nagar.
Cabinet Secretary Nasimul Ghani announced the decision during a briefing following a cabinet meeting on Sunday.
Work on the relocation process is expected to initiate shortly, with the goal of starting operations at the new location by 2029.
caption:
The Bangladesh Secretariat is moving. The government has approved its relocation to Sher-e-Bangla Nagar by 2029.

The government has decided to relocate the Bangladesh Secretariat to the former trade fair grounds in Sher-e-Bangla Nagar.

Cabinet Secretary Nasimul Ghani announced the decision during a briefing following a cabinet meeting on Sunday.

Work on the relocation process is expected to initiate shortly, with the goal of starting operations at the new location by 2029.

headline_marked: Jan 7: [[Amar Ekushey Book Fair to begin]] next year
headline: Jan 7: Amar Ekushey Book Fair to begin next year
summary: The month-long event, commemorating the language martyrs, will run from January 7 to February 6.
details: The Amar Ekushey Book Fair will begin on January 7 next year and continue until February 6.
The dates were finalized following a views-exchange programme with publishers' representatives on October 13 at the Bangla Academy.

The meeting was chaired by Cultural Affairs Minister Nitai Roy Chowdhury, with Prime Minister’s Adviser on Cultural Affairs Dr Zahed Ur Rahman and Cultural Affairs Secretary Yasmin Begum in attendance.
A notice signed by Bangla Academy Director General Mohammad Azam officially announced the dates.
The decision was reached through a unanimous agreement between the academy and publishers' representatives.
The annual fair is held to honor the martyrs of the 1952 Language Movement and celebrate Bengali language and literature.
